helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
helplines.authority: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs
helplines.description: National emergency helpline for reporting financial cyber fraud, digital arrests, and unauthorized bank transfers within the golden hour.

helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
helplines.authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
helplines.description: Official portal to file formal e-complaints and FIRs for cybercrimes, identity theft, financial fraud, and crimes against women/children.

helplines.name: Chakshu — Suspected Fraud Communication Facility
helplines.description: Report suspected fraudulent phone calls, fake SMS alerts, WhatsApp impersonation, and unauthorized KYC disconnection threats.

helplines.name: National Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
helplines.description: All-in-one emergency response for immediate police, medical, or fire assistance in case of physical threats or extortion.

helplines.name: CHILDLINE Emergency Helpline
helplines.description: 24x7 free emergency phone service for children in need of aid and assistance, cyberbullying, or online abuse involving minors.

helplines.name: Women Helpline (WHL)
helplines.description: 24-hour toll-free telephonic service providing counseling, immediate support, and legal guidance for women facing harassment or cyberstalking.

helplines.name: UIDAI Aadhaar Support Helpline
helplines.description: Support line to lock Aadhaar biometric access, verify authentication history, or report identity document misuse.

helplines.name: TRAI Do Not Disturb (DND) Registry
helplines.description: Register complaints against unsolicited commercial communications (UCC) and telemarketer harassment.

helplines.name: Stop Non-Consensual Intimate Images (StopNCII)
helplines.description: Generate unique digital hashes from private photos on your device to prevent them from being uploaded on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms.
